title: Verbs and tenses
description: Lær om verb i presens, preteritum og fremtid.

content.content:
## Verbs and Time

Verbs are action words - they tell us what someone does. In English, verbs change form to show when something happens:
- **Present** (now)
- **Past** (before)
- **Future** (later)

content.title: Present Tense
content.content:
**Present tense** - things that happen now or regularly

**Regular form:**
- I play football.
- We go to school.

**Third person (he/she/it) - add 's':**
- He plays football.
- She goes to school.

**Be-verbs:**
- I am, you are, he/she/it is
- we are, they are

**Examples:**
- I eat breakfast every day.
- She likes music.
- They are happy.

content.title: Past Tense
content.content:
**Past tense** - things that happened before

**Regular verbs - add 'ed':**
- play → played
- walk → walked
- watch → watched

**Irregular verbs (must be memorized):**
- go → went
- eat → ate
- see → saw
- have → had
- come → came
- make → made
- take → took

**Be-verbs in past:**
- I was, you were, he/she/it was
- we were, they were

content.title: Future Tense
content.content:
**Future tense** - things that will happen later

**Use "will" + verb:**
- I will go to school tomorrow.
- She will play football next week.
- They will visit us soon.

**Use "going to" + verb:**
- I am going to read a book tonight.
- We are going to travel this summer.

**Short form:** will = 'll
- I'll see you tomorrow!

content.title: Example: Same Verb in Different Tenses
content.problem: Use the verb "play" in present, past, and future:
content.solution:
**Present:**
- I play football every Saturday.
- He plays with his friends.

**Past:**
- I played football yesterday.
- She played with her dog.

**Future:**
- I will play football tomorrow.
- We are going to play after school.
